episodes.title: C'est toi le patron
episodes.summary: As filming kicks off, Raphaël struggles to assert his authority. A new stuntwoman is hired and a motivational speech in the cafeteria takes a wrong turn.

episodes.title: Mauvais bad buzz
episodes.summary: While Tom helps Raph dispose of evidence, Ingrid goes full method. Jean-Marc deals with an angry parent as he races to assemble 50,000 euros in cash.

episodes.title: Le buzz et l'argent du buzz
episodes.summary: The team follows a new lead in the hunt for the blackmailer. Desperate not to lose investment, Raph seeks out a TV journalist to boost his popularity.

episodes.title: Time's up
episodes.summary: As a high-risk plan marks the arrival of Bartabé on set, Raph uses CCTV footage to his benefit. Two very different parties take place on the same night.

episodes.title: Dans le rouge
episodes.summary: Eliott offers up a promising new clue. When filming moves from the studio to the Valande family farm, Raph searches for an old letter he never sent.

episodes.title: Action ou vérité
episodes.summary: When a broken-down bus keeps cast and crew at the farm, cash-strapped Jean-Marc looks for ways to cut costs and a game of truth or dare gets out of hand.

episodes.title: Les points sur les I
episodes.summary: At the series premiere, Jean-Marc and Tom make up while Magalie sets her sights on her crush. Raph makes a last-ditch attempt to unmask the blackmailer.
